## Exempt reads

| Type | Property | Kind | Rationale |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress` | `Description` | not-a-trigger | a description change updates the rule in place (#6514); revoke + authorize follows only when AWS no longer has the rule or the recorded description is redacted |
| `AWS::Route53::RecordSet` | `SetIdentifier` | cfn-update | CloudFormation shows an update; the record is swapped in one atomic change batch, so the name never stops resolving |

| `AWS::SNS::Subscription` | `RawMessageDelivery` | not-a-trigger | the attribute plan sets it in place, and resets it when removed (RESET_VALUES) |
